images.title: Navakankari: a line of three
images.purpose: Shows the Navakankari board and the goal of the game: three pawns in a line.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no characters, no extra text. One square board centred with wide margins, and three pawns forming a line along its top edge.
images.exact_structure: Three nested squares with thin dark outlines, centred. Four straight segments join the midpoints of the sides: each runs from the midpoint of a side of the outer square, through the midpoint of the matching side of the middle square, to the midpoint of the matching side of the inner square, and does not enter the inner square. Each square has 8 marked points, its 4 corners and 4 side midpoints, drawn as small dark dots: 24 points in all. Three teal (#0072B2) pawns sit on the top side of the outer square, at its top left corner, top midpoint and top right corner. A reddish purple (#CC79A7) bar runs behind the three pawns, labelled line of three above it. One amber (#E69F00) pawn sits on the left midpoint of the middle square. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Three pawns in a straight line on the board make a line of three.
images.description: Shows the Navakankari board and the goal of the game: three pawns in a line.
images.context: Board: 3 squares × 8 points = 24 points; each player has 9 pawns.

image_decisions.why: The board's shape and the line of three are the core of the game, best shown in one picture.
